map.海洋风暴潮预警 使用指南: Marine Storm Surge Warning User Guide
map.输入台风中心气压、最大风速和移动方向，估算气压效应增水、风力效应增水及总风暴潮增: Enter the typhoon central pressure, maximum wind speed and direction of movement to estimate the pressure surge, wind surge and total storm surge height.
map.由最大风速估风增水高度辅警风暴潮。: Estimate wind surge height from maximum wind speed as a storm surge advisory.
map.叠天文潮判断超警戒水位风险。: Overlay the astronomical tide to judge the risk of exceeding the warning water level.
map.沿海防汛预置排涝与撤离。: Coastal flood defence: pre-position drainage and evacuation.
map.：最大风速 vmax=30 m/s、重力加速度 G=9.8、方向系数 1 → 风: : Maximum wind speed vmax = 30 m/s, gravitational acceleration G = 9.8, direction factor 1 gives wind surge dh = 0.003 x 30^2/9.8 x 1, about 0.275 m = 27.5 cm; if an astronomical spring tide is superimposed and exceeds the warning level, a warning is issued.
map.：增水+天文潮超警戒 0.5m 蓝色、1m 黄色、2m 橙色、3m 红色，本例: : Surge plus astronomical tide exceeding the warning level by 0.5 m is blue, 1 m yellow, 2 m orange and 3 m red; the 27.5 cm in this example gives no warning on its own, but needs rechecking when a spring tide is superimposed.
map.风增水只是风暴潮一部分？: Is wind surge only part of a storm surge?
map.是。总增水=风增水+气压增水（每降 1hPa 约 +1cm）+天文潮，三者叠加才: Yes. Total surge = wind surge + pressure surge (about +1 cm per 1 hPa drop) + astronomical tide; only the three combined determine the final water level.
map.蓝色预警就撤离吗？: Does a blue warning mean evacuate?
map.不。蓝色为最低级提示，红色（增水≥3m）才启动大规模撤离，以本地预案为准。: No. Blue is the lowest-level advisory; only red (surge >=3 m) triggers large-scale evacuation, and the local plan governs.
